subject: [SYNTHETIC] Cracked vial and then a rash — fictional dual-label case
body:
This is synthetic mailbox data for the Clinevo reviewer prototype. No real patient, reporter, or product complaint is described.

Casey Nguyen, 47-year-old woman, received Examplemab lot EX-2209 from a vial with a cracked neck, then developed fever and rash. Photo of the vial was mentioned. This should classify as both a safety report and a quality complaint.
